_about: Set effects of gear in the public launch build (公測 1.0), from the table 9.3.4 of 666bj's guide on NGA (tid 47985685, posted 2026-11-26, an image in floor 9; the guide states it was written with AI help), read 2026-11-28 and restated as facts. 叫我棉被's chart of 長空協奏 (BV1VQ1WzRER9, 2:30) shows the same values (2 pieces 120, 4 pieces 8%, 15 s, 3 stacks). The third-test text of each set is in records/gear.json. Rendered by pipeline/build_pages.py as the section 公測的套裝效果 of systems/gear.
